# Third-party client libraries

The following unmodified browser distributions are included locally so that
the application does not download executable code from third-party CDNs at
runtime.

| Component | Version | License | Runtime file | SHA-256 |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| SheetJS Community Edition | 0.20.3 | Apache-2.0 | `xlsx-0.20.3.full.min.js` | `CC015130AA8521E7F088F88898EBA949CCDCBFB38DF0BD129B44B7273C3A6F41` |
| JSZip | 3.10.1 | MIT or GPL-3.0 | `jszip-3.10.1.min.js` | `ACC7E41455A80765B5FD9C7EE1B8078A6D160BBBCA455AEAE854DE65C947D59E` |
| jsPDF | 2.5.1 | MIT | `jspdf-2.5.1.umd.min.js` | `98CCF17AA10C20BB1301762618FCC9B6AB3A4E7F26B6071D64D0B41154DF3875` |
| html2canvas | 1.4.1 | MIT | `html2canvas-1.4.1.min.js` | `E87E550794322E574A1FDA0C1549A3C70DAE5A93D9113417A429016838EAB8CB` |
| PptxGenJS | 3.12.0 | MIT | `pptxgenjs-3.12.0.bundle.js` | `CD078CA9E91C6F9E061EE0A3C310D6FF157C3A71B1DEA7F40FD53818017266FF` |

The corresponding license texts are stored in the `licenses` directory.
Original download locations:

- https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js
- https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jszip/3.10.1/jszip.min.js
- https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf/2.5.1/jspdf.umd.min.js
- https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2canvas/1.4.1/html2canvas.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/gitbrent/pptxgenjs@3.12.0/dist/pptxgen.bundle.js
